text:
## Abstract

This report documents the readiness process for variant calling of RNA-Seq reads from GEO Series GSE309890 against the Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655 genome. The study identified six SRA runs associated with the BioProject accession PRJNA1363958. The K-12 MG1655 genome assembly GCF_000005845.2, meeting reference genome completeness and haploid ploidy, was validated as compatible with the workflow "Paired end variant calling in haploid system." Workflow inputs were partially resolved, requiring paired sequencing data from SRA for finalization. This will enable sensitive genomic variation analysis using mapped RNA reads against the bacterial genome.

## I. Introduction

**Background.** RNA-Seq data from GSE309890 investigates how SSRI antidepressants, particularly sertraline, impact resistance emergence in bacteria such as E. coli.

**Literature Review.** No PubMed link is registered for PRJNA1363958.

**Knowledge Gap.** Variant calling information about genomic mutations underlying metabolic modifications induced by sertraline is yet unexplored.

**Objective & Hypothesis.** To call variants using RNA-Seq reads from GSE309890 mapped against Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655.

## II. Materials and Methods

**Study Design.** Focused on GEO study GSE309890 RNA-Seq reads aligned against K-12 MG1655 genome.

**Materials.** 
- **GSE309890 metadata and SRA runs:** Retrieved via GEO and SRA tools.
- **Reference genome assembly:** GCF_000005845.2.
- **Workflow:** "Paired end variant calling in haploid system."

**Procedures.** 
1. Extracted six SRA RNA-Seq runs for PRJNA1363958.
2. Validated genome assembly GCF_000005845.2 for compatibility.
3. Partially resolved workflow inputs.

**Statistical Analysis.** Counted 6 paired SRA runs mapped to K-12 MG1655 TaxID 511145.

## III. Results

**Data Presentation.**
| Run Accession | Average Length | Platform | Download Path                                         |
|---------------|----------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------|
| SRR36018645   | 300 bp         | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | [Link](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018645/SRR36018645.lite.1) |
| SRR36018644   | 300 bp         | Illumina HiSeq 4000 | [Link](https://sra-downloadb.be-md.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sos10/sra-pub-zq-1002/SRR036/36018/SRR36018644/SRR36018644.lite.1) |
| ...           | ...            | ...      | ...                                                   |

(Table continues for all 6 runs)

**Findings.** 
- Six RNA-Seq runs suitable for paired-layout processing.
- GCF_000005845.2 compatible with haploid variant calling workflow.
- Remaining inputs: paired collections specified in the SRA source.

## IV. Discussion

**Interpretation.** The SRA runs, paired with assembly GCF_000005845.2, are compatible for variant analysis using the defined workflow.

**Context.** GEO metadata and resolved assembly inputs establish robust pairing between experimental RNA data and the reference genome.

**Limitations.** BioProject metadata lacked validation via associated literature (PubMed).

**Conclusion & Future Directions.** Workflow readiness is ideal for continued variant identification within GSE309890. Proceeding next step involves initiating paired collection input setup for running "haploid variant-calling."

## References

1. GEO Series GSE309890 metadata: [Link](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890).
2. SRA BioProject PRJNA1363958 runs metadata: [Source](https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov).
3. Genome reference assembly: [UCSC Browser](https://genome.ucsc.edu).

## Acknowledgments

I thank NCBI Geo and SRA for sequencing project archival/tracking systems. Assistance for BRC IWC was critical.
